interaction_steps.prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "ls -a && find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -name PROJECT_BRIEF.md | head -30 && sed -n '1,240p' resolver/resolver.go && rg -n \"ReportError|UpdateState|resolver.*error|ResolveNow|failfast|FailFast\" --glob '*.go' . | head -120"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' resolver_conn_wrapper.go && sed -n '1,220p' picker_wrapper.go && sed -n '1,200p' pickfirst.go && rg -n \"NewPicker|UpdateState|scResolver|resolverWrapper|ccResolver\" clientconn.go"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '510,590p' clientconn.go && sed -n '90,175p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go && sed -n '1090,1140p' clientconn.go && sed -n '100,175p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '45,115p' balancer/base/balancer.go && sed -n '390,450p' balancer/grpclb/grpclb.go && sed -n '285,335p' balancer/balancer.go && cat go.mod | head"
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go balancer/base/balancer.go pickfirst.go && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff'

/bin/zsh -lc "gofmt -w resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short && rg -n \"resolver\\.ClientConn interface|resolver\\.ClientConn\" --glob '*.go' | head -50"
